theory.title: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso
theory.explanation: Usa will be + verbo en -ing para hablar de una acción que estará en curso en un momento concreto del futuro. También puede servir para preguntar educadamente por los planes de alguien: This time next year, more people will be working from home (por estas fechas el año que viene, más personas estarán trabajando desde casa).
theory.tip: Future continuous = will be + verbo en -ing.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 1
patterns.pattern: This time next year, I will be studying abroad.
examples:
This time next year, I will be studying abroad.
→ Por estas fechas el año que viene, estaré estudiando en el extranjero.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 2
patterns.pattern: At eight tomorrow, the council will be meeting residents.
examples:
At eight tomorrow, the council will be meeting residents.
→ Mañana a las ocho, el ayuntamiento estará reuniéndose con los vecinos.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 3
patterns.pattern: More people will be cycling to work in the future.
examples:
More people will be cycling to work in the future.
→ En el futuro, más personas irán en bicicleta al trabajo.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 4
patterns.pattern: Will you be using the car this evening?
examples:
Will you be using the car this evening?
→ ¿Estarás utilizando el coche esta tarde?

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 5
patterns.pattern: The city will be building new cycle lanes next spring.
examples:
The city will be building new cycle lanes next spring.
→ La ciudad estará construyendo nuevos carriles bici la próxima primavera.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 6
patterns.pattern: At noon, volunteers will be collecting donations.
examples:
At noon, volunteers will be collecting donations.
→ Al mediodía, los voluntarios estarán recogiendo donaciones.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 7
patterns.pattern: We won't be driving into the centre tomorrow.
examples:
We won't be driving into the centre tomorrow.
→ Mañana no estaremos entrando en el centro en coche.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 8
patterns.pattern: Will they be planting trees at the weekend?
examples:
Will they be planting trees at the weekend?
→ ¿Estarán plantando árboles durante el fin de semana?

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 9
patterns.pattern: This time tomorrow, the team will be presenting its plan.
examples:
This time tomorrow, the team will be presenting its plan.
→ Mañana a esta hora, el equipo estará presentando su plan.

patterns.label: Futuro continuo para acciones en curso · 10
patterns.pattern: In ten years, many homes will be producing their own energy.
examples:
In ten years, many homes will be producing their own energy.
→ Dentro de diez años, muchas viviendas estarán produciendo su propia energía.

content.passage: The city council has announced a ten-year plan for greener neighbourhoods. This time next year, workers will be building new cycle lanes and planting trees near schools. At the same time, volunteers will be collecting ideas from local residents. Many families will be using electric buses, and some homes will be producing their own energy. The council hopes that these changes will make the city healthier and easier to travel around.

items.prompt: Describe what your town will be doing in five years.
items.modelAnswer: In five years, I think my town will be improving its public transport and creating more green spaces. The old industrial area may be becoming a place for homes and small businesses. I hope the changes will make life easier for residents.

items.prompt: What will you be doing this time next weekend?
items.modelAnswer: This time next weekend, I'll be visiting my grandparents and helping them in the garden. We will probably be having lunch outside if the weather is warm. I won't be checking work emails.

items.prompt: Talk about how people will be travelling in the future.
items.modelAnswer: People will probably be travelling more by electric buses, trains and bicycles. Cities may introduce more car-free streets, although cars will still be necessary in some areas. I hope transport will become cleaner and more affordable.

items.prompt: Ask a friend politely about their plans using will you be…?
items.modelAnswer: Will you be working late on Thursday, or will you be free to come to the community meeting? I need to know because we are organising the volunteers. We can meet online if travelling is difficult.

items.prompt: Describe a project that will be happening in your area.
items.modelAnswer: A new sports centre will be being built near the school next year. Local groups will be organising activities there, and the council will be improving the footpaths around it. It should give young people more places to meet.

items.prompt: What will schools be teaching about the environment?
items.modelAnswer: Schools will be teaching students how to save energy, reduce waste and understand climate change. They may also be organising practical projects, such as planting trees or measuring the school's electricity use.

items.prompt: Explain how homes will be using energy in the future.
items.modelAnswer: Many homes will be using solar panels and smart systems to control heating. Better insulation will reduce the amount of energy people need. These changes could lower bills as well as pollution.

items.prompt: Talk about what volunteers will be doing at an event.
items.modelAnswer: At the festival, volunteers will be welcoming visitors, collecting rubbish and helping people find the different activities. Some will be working at information points, while others will be supporting the performers.

items.prompt: Describe changes you expect to be seeing in ten years.
items.modelAnswer: In ten years, I expect to be seeing more electric vehicles and safer cycle routes. Local shops may be using less packaging, and buildings could be more energy-efficient. I hope these changes will be visible in everyday life.

items.prompt: Give a prediction about how your city will be changing.
items.modelAnswer: My city will probably be changing by creating more pedestrian areas and improving train connections. If planning is done carefully, people will have more choices about how to travel. I hope the city will remain welcoming for everyone.

B: Are they also organising recycling activities? A: Yes, and they want to explain how to save energy. B: That sounds useful. A: The organisers have received a lot of support and hope to continue the project in the future.
